messages:
support_erin: Filing on behalf of customer jdoe — TS/browser SDK streaming: after midstream 401 the client reconnects but the final JSON object is cut off (trailing '}' missing) so parser errors and UI hangs. Happens ~30% of reconnects. Repro attached.
customer-jdoe: Repro steps — SPA using @redwood/sdk-js EventSource wrapper + AbortController. Sequence: start stream, token expires, 401 midstream, we call refresh token then reconnect; on reconnect sometimes last chunk missing. Logs: 
customer-jdoe: ```resp-chunk: \"..., \\\"choices\\\":[{...}],\" partial=\"true\"\nresp-chunk: \"...\\\"role\\\":\\\"assistant\\\",\\\"content\\\":\\\"...\\n\``` 
sam: can you paste the fetch/EventSource code snippet? what SDK version?
customer-jdoe: sdk-js v2.1.0, code:
customer-jdoe: ```ts
const ctrl = new AbortController();
const es = new EventSource(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
es.onmessage = (e)=> handleChunk(e.data);
// on 401 we do ctrl.abort(); refreshToken().then(()=> reconnect());
```
sam: hmm EventSource ignores AbortController; JS wrapper does a close() + recreate. @nina any known regressions around final-chunk flush on reconnect?
nina: saw something similar with streaming proxy where final buffer flush not awaited when connection closes abruptly. Eng-runtime: do we atomically flush tail tokens when we receive 401 midstream? @jia
eng-runtime: we only flush when buffer full or on normal end-stream signal. If connection closes due to auth error we may not send final EOF event. Could explain missing closing brace. We'll add a forced flush on token error path.
sdk-ts-bot: possible client-side double-send on reconnect? if both old and new connections overlap kernel may re-send last token causing duplication. Could also explain duplicate UI content.
customer-jdoe: also seeing duplicate last sentence in ~10% of sessions, so both missing brace and occasional duplicate. Looks like race between close and reconnect.
sam: can you share X-Request-Id from logs?
customer-jdoe: x-req=rn-8c9a; posted logs below.
customer-jdoe: ```
[11:02:23] 401 from /v1/streams?model=gpt-x id=rn-8c9a
[11:02:23] client reconnect attempt 1
[11:02:23] new conn established
[11:02:23] server partial chunk: ...\"content\":\"...\\n\"
[11:02:23] old conn closed (socket end)
[11:02:23] parser error: unexpected end of JSON
```
nina: thanks. Actions: (1) eng-runtime push to force tail-flush on auth-close; (2) SDK team to ensure we wait for server-side 'end' event, avoid recreating EventSource until transport fully closed; (3) add sequence-id header to each chunk to dedupe on client.
jia: I'll PR runtime patch; sam can you file SDK change to wait 200ms after close before new EventSource or use a small backoff + idempotency check? (avoid arbitrary sleep in long term)
sam: will do a proper reconnect handshake instead of blind reopen. Add 'stream-seq' header.
support_erin: customer wants a hotfix ASAP and a mitigation they can apply now — suggested: downgrade to sdk-js v2.0.5? is that safer?
sam: v2.0.5 used a slightly different reconnect logic that didn't overlap connections but had other issues. If they can tolerate potential slower reconnect, recommend adding client dedupe by last-chunk-hash: store last chunk hash and ignore repeat.
customer-jdoe: can you confirm if billing double-charge risk exists? we saw two partial token counts once.
eng-runtime: billing: tokens charged when server acknowledges generation; if duplicate token sent by overlap might count twice. We'll verify; for now recommend pausing production and applying mitigation.
support_erin: assigning eng-runtime + sdk-ts owners; will update customer with mitigation steps.
sam: adding issue links and next steps: PRs, rollback plan, and postmortem template.
support_erin: thanks :thumbsup:
